notes.title: Patch 1.41
notes.content:
Deer Gamers! 

Just another small patch. v1.4 improved the games performance while displaying the minimap in big rooms. But after releasing v1.4 I was reviewing the minimap code and thought of a way to make it more efficient in general.

Previously the minimap was drawn square by square which was very inefficient as it was drawing ~1600-2500 squares on the screen each frame. It's now done row-by-row in a few rectangles based on the terrain. 

In practice it appears the same as before, but behind the scenes it's about 10x more efficient.

[b]QoL[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the performance of the minimap.
[/list]
Thanks for playing,

Azzie

notes.title: Patch 1.14
notes.content:
Deer Gamers!

Just a quick update to fix a reported bug and a performance improvement to the minimaps introduced in the last version.

[b]QoL[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue which caused the Minimap to be more performance intensive than necessary in bigger rooms. 

In v1.13 the minimap was processing the entire room when updating positions of objects, causing it to be more performance intensive the bigger the room was. This has been changed to refreshing just slightly wider than size of the Minimap to improve performance and ensure big rooms aren't more performance intensive.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where after the escape sequence at the end of Chapter 5 if the player gets a Gameover in the overworld (e.g. reaching 0 HP by falling down a pit, or getting hit by a hazard) during a the same play session the game would inappropriately present the 'Retry' option on the gameover screen. Retry in battle would still correctly return the player to the start of the battle. in v1.14 Retry should only display during lost battles or in the middle of Escape Sequences and minigames. 

Repeating the sequence described above in v1.13 Retry would reload the game and send the player back to the start of the Escape Sequence. The game now correctly flags the player as not in the chase sequence once it's completed so Retry will only appear when appropriate.
[/list]
Also some good news! Reindeer Story is also nearing another milestone It's sold 197 copies at the time of writing, 200 is what I wanted to reach by the start of November so getting close to it 3 months in advance is great! Big thanks to everyone who bought Reindeer Story, I really appreciate it!

Thanks for reading,

~Azzie

notes.title: Patch 1.13 - Minimaps ahoy!
notes.content: [p]Hi Deer Gamers![/p][p]Reindeer Story is 7 months old now, over half a year! Time flies and I'm glad to announce two nice milestones of over 150 copies sold (close to 170) and 10 positive reviews! Maybe not reached quite as fast as I've hoped but I'm glad to reach these milestones especially outside of the holiday season! [b]Thank you[/b] for the support! ːsteamhappyː[/p][p][i]Hopefully I can reach 200 copies by November and 250 or maybe even 300 by the end of the year :)[/i][/p][p]On the RPG front Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 and Deltarune's Chapter 3 & 4 came out since the release of Reindeer Story. I've been having fun playing and beating them! [/p][p]But without further adieu, a new version of Reindeer Story has been released with a new feature, a [b]Minimap[/b]! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42688717/d472a661aab8b616847fff7e53d4e1fd415a9c16.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Functionality[/b][/p][p][b]Minimap[/b] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42688717/0de342614384fca1c6e70c05de104c85f0088848.png"][/img][/p][p]If you press [b]Select[/b] (controller) or [b]Backspace[/b] (Keyboard) in the overworld a [b]minimap[/b] appears! You can toggle between a small minimap, a larger minimap and no minimap by pressing Select or Backspace! [i]The small minimap will appear by default[/i] [/p][p]It displays a fairly large area around Lux, which should help navigate the game locations. It will show the player as a green dot on the map. It shows treasure as a blue dot[/p][p]It also shows Cherubs as a pink dot on the map. If a Cherub has already been rescued they'll display as a grey dot. So it's helpful for finding those last couple Cherubs in each of the games locations! [/p][p][b]QoL[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the positioning of action icons in the UI (e.g. for Jumping, interacting, etc.) so they do not get cut off in smaller/zoomed in screens.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the position of coins in some maps which were too close to walls to be collected.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the collisions in many of the games maps to account for the new minimaps. [/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the difficulty of the Preliminary Gauntlet in Chapter 2 (Removed a few obstacles and added HP recovery pickups).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bugfixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug which caused Jo and Patch to continue to appear in the ReToyner's base in Chapter 3 after completing the Toy Train.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug which would cause Wendigo's snowmobile sprites not to appear if you return to Snowzone and ride a snowmobile during certain sections of the game while he's party leader.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing Reindeer Story, please continue to provide feedback and reviews. I read all of the feedback and it helps for Reindeer Story and future games! [/p][p]Best Wishes,[/p][p]Azzie [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.12 - Jukebox update
notes.content:
Hi  Deer Gamers!

I've released version 1.12 of Reindeer Story! As with last time, I'm aiming to use January to apply changes based on feedback from the community and reviews! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42688717/a831f0bd8ad9bc240e189e629c460833b6ba4636.png[/img]
This patch introduces a new option on the Title Screen, 'Options' which replaces 'Steam'. On the Options you can set the Text Speed and Volume Settings. Any settings set while the titlescreen will carry across to, New Game+ or Load Game saves. If no options are set then the game will use the defaults when starting a new game, or when loading a save it will load that save's previous settings. 

I've added a Juke Box to the ground floor Five Gold Rings Hotel in Sweet Street, where you you can listen to the game's music! This will be available once you reach chapter 4. I hope everyone enjoys listening to the game's soundtrack!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42688717/c833c6b3bf57351d6b18ed02add7f5c8fd43f9e8.png[/img]

[b]New Functionality [/b]
[list]
[*] Replaced the Steam option on the title screen with Options. 
[*] Added a Juke box to Sweet Street.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42688717/1a866d15e5943ea419f7c43d118a4fc90d2c0f5e.png[/img]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug which caused a crash when trying to return to the previous screen on the last screen of Chestnut Falls.
[*] Fixed a bug which caused a certain area of the tracks of the Toy Train not to be counted as a pitfall.
[*] Fixed a bug which caused the player to appear on the wrong spot when backtracking to the room before the Chase with Mousestein.
[/list]

Thanks again for playing Reindeer Story! I'll continue to keep an eye out for feedback and reviews even past the holiday season, whether it's November, December, January or June I'll be listening! 

Thanks for reading!

Azzie!

notes.title: Patch 1.11 - Snowmobile Adjustments
notes.content:
Happy New Year Deer Gamers!

Hope you all had a great holiday! It's a new year with new goals. I'm aiming to use January to work through the feedback for Reindeer Story and make as many changes as possible to improve the experience! 

This patch is focused on the Snowmobile, there were a lot of critiques regarding the speed and control. Changes have been made to enhance the level of control the player has over the snowmobile and address the issues. Please let me know what you think of the changes! 

Changes have been made to slightly reduce the speed of the Snowmobile and dampen the effect of turning as the vehicle speeds up to make high speed controls feel less volatile. 

Functionality has been added when holding Accelerate and Break at the same time on the Snowmobile. It will have the snowmobile accelerate or decelerate to a slower fixed speed comparable to Lux's running speed with strong turning ability. Using this you can gain more precise control over the vehicle when needed while keeping moderate speed, and release break when you want maximum speed! 

[b]QoL[/b]
[list]
[*] The following changes have been made to improve the experience in the Snowmobile:
[*] Reduced Top Speed of Snowmobile by 10%.
[*] Increased Jump Height of Snowmobile off ramps by 10%.
[*] When travelling above half of the Snowmobile's top speed the turning will gradually reduce by up to 33%.
[/list]
[b]New Functionality [/b]
[list]
[*] Holding both Accelerate (Jump) and Break (Cancel) simultaneously while riding a snowmobile will have the Snowmobile accelerate or decelerate to 55% top speed, which is comparable to Lux's speed while dashing. 
[*] If you're not riding the Snowmobile when you enter a screen with checkpoint flags in the Snowzone or Jack Frost's domain the snowmobile will automatically be summoned at the nearest checkpoint flag. 
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed collisions in the Tinsel Town Church that lead to it being possible to get trapped behind the walls near the bookcases.
[*] Fixed a typo in Enoch's dialogue in Tinsel Town church.
[/list]
That's all for today's changes, I'll be working on more of the feedback and keeping an eye out for further feedback so any reviews or comments are appreciated!

As mentioned earlier if you play with the newly adjusted Snowmobile mechanics let me know what you think, I'll make some further adjustments if needed!

Thanks,

Azzie

notes.title: Merry Christmas!
notes.content:
Merry Christmas Deer Gamers! 

I got a few Christmas presents today, but the best one is seeing the results of Reindeer Story's launch! 

Between Steam and Itch.io it's reached over 100 sales (nearly 110, though with steam doing the heavy lifting lol) and every review has been positive on Steam, Every review 5 stars on Itch!

notes.title: Patch v1.08
notes.content:
Hi Deer Gamers! 

Just a follow up todays earlier patch the first was covered in version 1.071 but figured I'd include it here officially!

Due to an oversight in the games script files interacting with the Naughty & Nice text option. This lead to certain lines of dialogue being duplicated in game, this didn't affect much of the games texthowever because this would affect every playthrough I prioritised getting this out ASAP rather than as v1.08 as the other fix was fairly time consuming.

The second was a pretty tricky crash in the Equipment menu! After equipping an item or backing out from the equipment/item panes there was a 1/30th of a second (2 frames)  where the players inventory and equipment menu display was being adjusted by the game. 

In the previous version moving the cursor in certain ways and pressing confirm during this tiny window would cause the game to get confused which sub-menu it was meant to be displaying! This lead to unintended data being sometimes returned as the ID of the item that the player is hovering over, and in cases where this number was larger than the number of items in the game it would crash attempting to return non-existent data! I was able to prevent invalid IDs being output and went further and tackled the route cause to be extra safe.

[h1]Bugfixes
[/h1][list]
[*] Fixed an oversight in the games script files which caused some lines of dialogue to be duplicated.
[*] Fixed a rare crash bug in the Equipment menu which certain cursor movement and input commands during a 2 frame window after equipping an item which would cause the game to attempt to search for a non-existing item and crash the game.
[/list]

Hope these changes improve the experience! Please keep raising issues and I'll try my best to resolve these!

Thanks,

Azzie

notes.title: Patch 1.07!
notes.content:
Hi Deer players! 

Just deploying another small patch to improve the general gameplay experience. I've solved a couple of very situational soft-locks and an issue surrounding Lux's nose glow in the overworld sometimes appearing on the battle screen! 

Functionality Change
[list]
[*] If you trigger a scene while being chased by an enemy in the overworld they will stop chasing you and move back to their initial position. This is to prevent certain enemies from moving and waiting at the players position during the scene an triggering an unavoidable battle once the scene completes! 
[/list]

Bugfixes
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where if you charged up Lux's nose in the overworld and enter a battle the glow would sometimes appear on the battle zone. This usually happened in very small rooms as the glow would appear the same co-ordinates in battle as Lux was in the room (so in bigger rooms it would not be visible as it'd often be off-screen).
[*]The above also fixed a case where if you charged up Lux's nose before battle finishing the battle would immediately fire a nose beam after battle.
[*]Fixed a bug where in certain locations if you are prompted to use an item (e.g. using a bell to enter Toy Tower in chapter 3) and an enemy triggers a battle while you are selecting an item the game will softlock when the battle starts. Now while you are selecting  an item the enemies will not trigger a battle and will also cease chasing you.
[*]Fixed a similar softlock where if an enemy triggers a battle with you in the overworld while you are next to an NPC who starts a scene and you trigger that scene during the battle transition.
[*]Fixed a bug which prevented Mousestein's post chapter 3 dialogue in the Toy Town equipment shop from appearing before starting his side quest at the wishlist.
[/list]

As always thanks for playing, and keep providing feedback! 

Azzie!

notes.title: Patch v1.06!
notes.content:
Hi Deer Players, 

Another week another new version! This time there's two minor bugs reported with mimic present boxes and a repeatable triggered battle in Chapter 3.

Bugfixes
* Fixed a bug that made it possible to open present boxes you're standing next to on the overworld, while the pause screen is open. 
* The above fixes a glitch in previous versions. Where if you open the menu screen you save your game while next to a Mimic present boxes. It would trigger the battle and then the game would softlock afterwards. Reloading the save you made would reload before the battle but with the chest open leading to lost rewards.
* Fixed a bug in Chapter 3 on the Toy Town screen with the Item and Equipment shops. In previous versions If you speak to one of the two Mouse Guards that trigger battles, win the battle, then immediately talk to them the game would softlock. 
*The above was due to an oversight where both guards were being treat as the same NPC, getting moved to the same co-ordinates after the 1st battle. When you talked to them a 2nd time, it'd create two of the same scene at once causing a soft-lock as one of them would not be registered as completed. This was fixed by making a separate NPC type for the 2nd guard which restored expected behaviour to the NPCs.

QoL
* Fixed a typo in Lux and Robin's conversation in the Retoyner's base in Chapter 3.

Thanks for reading, and please keep reporting any issues and feedback! This helps make the game better! 

Azzie

notes.title: Patch 1.05!
notes.content:
Hi Deer Players,

A week after launch and I'm still to see more positive reviews and a fairly good start in terms of players! I've got a few changes and tweaks for v1.05 based on some bug reports, and some oddities I've discovered myself while testing the bug fixes. 

[b]Functionality Changes[/b]
[i]In previous versions if you could get down into the lower level of the colosseum screen in Autumn Arena there was an invisible wall I placed between the ledge and the lower level but it was found jumping at a certain position can sometimes allow the player to fall through it, causing a softlock.[/i]

[list]
[*] Removed the invisible wall between the upper and lower levels of the Colosseum in Autumn Arena.
[*] Made it possible to leave the lower portion of the Colosseum in Autumn Arena, except during the Joust Minigames and when collecting the Grand Present.
[*] Added missing music to the Joust at Autumn Arena.
[*] Changed Minigame music to be set to the default music for the area after minigame completion rather than the last track played.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[i]A few minor bugfixes were made for this version. I found the final Joust against Chestni did not reward the Walnut item correctly and a bed in Autumn Village would crash the game due to a missing effects layer for the green healing flash effect. The Gauntlet in Autumn Arena has been made inaccessible after first completion due to not being intended to be repeated[/i]

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash which would occur when trying to sleep in a bed in one of the Chestnut houses in Autumn Village. 
[*] Fixed a bug which prevented Wallnuts appearing in the rewards from the Joust against Chestni.
[*] Fixed a bug which allowed the player to re-enter the Gauntlet in Autumn Arena after completing it the first time, leading to a softlock. 
[*] Fixed a few typos and a missing NPC dialogue in Autumn Village and Autumn Arena.
[*] Fixed a room transition on the east wing of Autumn Arena which would skip the room with the stairway to the colosseum when heading north. 
[/list]

[b]QoL[/b]
[list]
[*] Slightly increased the volume of the Snowzone exploration track.
[/list]

I hope these changes help improve the experience of Reindeer Story, thanks for playing and please keep providing feedback as it's helpful for these patches!

Thanks for reading,

Azzie

notes.title: Demo update v1.07
notes.content:
This demo update overhauls the game visually and contains many improvements made designing the full game now applied to the Prototype Demo!

This list contains most major changes, but there may be many unreported adjustments and improvements made in this version! Enjoy! 

Regarding the updated controllers in addition to the already supported Xbox 360 controller.  The Xbox Series X controller and the Nintendo Switch Pro Controller have been tested! I changed it to support all controllers supported by Gamemaker Studio 2 so I imagine there's much wider support. 

If you're using a different controller type could you check it works? 

Graphical Changes
-------------------
- Updated graphics for Player Characters, NPCs and enemies
- Many icons, including moves and icons have been updated

Main Menu Changes
------------------
- Changed the Layout of the Menu screen
- Menu Screen now displays the current playtime 
- Menu Screen now displays the Location Name
- Added an option to Quit Game or Return to the Title screen

- Added an Options menu that allows a large number of functions
General Options 
-Text Speed Option (WIP),
-SFX, Ambience and Music Volume controls

Difficulty Options
- Easy, Hard and Seasons Beatings Mode to ease or increase difficulty (Default: Normal)
- EXP Option - An option to turn EXP gain ON/OFF for challenge (Default: ON)
- Timed Hit Assist - Automatically make timed hit in Battle (Default: OFF)

Control Options
It's now possible to remap controls for Gamepad and Keyboard and mouse! be aware in previous versions multiple
keys were originally bound to the same actions. Now there is only one default Keyboard Control scheme that you can
remap. 

The default controls for Gamepad have been adjusted to fit the Xbox360 control scheme as a default, 
Also expanded the controller support to every type Gamemaker Studio can support. This has been tested with the
Xbox 360 controller, Nintendo Switch Pro Controller and the Xbox Series X controller. But it's very likely to work
with many more controllers! 

Language Options - (WIP)
- A Language option has been added, currently English is the only option however the game's text files have been designed with other languages
  in mind. If you are interested in translating Reindeer Story into a different non-english language do get in touch!

Overworld Changes 
--------------------
UI 
- The UI in the overworld is now translucent and becomes opaque to indicate when a button is being pressed! 

New Items
-----------
- Snowcones: restores HP and Energy
- Candle : Deals Red Elemental Damage to the enemies

Battle Changes
---------------
- A yellow circle now appears under the characters that indicates the player's hitbox.
- Enemies now account for the players Charisma stat when choosing which player to attack in abttle.

Balance Changes
---------------
- Characters starting stats have been adjusted.
- Many skills have had their power and energy costs adjusted. The amount of additional energy cost when placing skills in more powerful slots has generally been reduced.
- Many items and tokens used to boost HP have had their HP bonus reduced, such as Healthy Heart. These were once in-line with Energy Boosting but 
  in practice HP is more valuable.
- Robin's Z-Mana Skill has been changed to place down a present in the Battle Zone which can be collected on later turns by any character.

Difficulty Modes
-----------------
In this version Difficulty modes have been introduced, these impact the enemies stats and some other details. Enemy Attack Levels impact the speed of projectiles and the length of time you need to avoid them
making them generally harder to dodge. The harder difficulties present a more intense challenge without drawing out battles, tougher foes but faster Z-Meter charge! Easy mode reduces the enemies damage
for a more casual play style, combine with the timed hit assist.  

Easy              
- Reduce enemy HP by 10% 
- Reduce the damage foes deal by 25% (rounded down)
- Reduce the level of foes attack by 1.

Normal          
- Default Difficulty

Hard              
 - All foes HP multiplied by 10% (rounded up)
 - Increase the level of foes attack by 2, increasing the length and speed.
 - Foes attacks deal 1.25x damage (rounded down) + 1
 - Players Z-Meter charges 25% faster

Seasons' Beatings -
- All foes HP increased by 2
- All foes HP increased by a further 20% (rounded down)
- All foes DEF increased by 1
- All foes DEF multiplied by 1.25 (rounded down)
- Increase the level of foes attack by 4, increasing the length and speed.
- Foes attacks deal 1.5x damage (rounded down) + 2
- Players Z-Meter charges 50% faster

Any feedback regarding the difficuty modes would be greatly appreciated!

Misc Changes
------------------
- Reduced the volume of some of the music tracks.
- Significantly reduced the length of fade outs between rooms.
- Substantially cut down time taken to Load a Game.
- Added more support for controllers
- More Sound Effects and visual effects have been added to moves in battle
- Robin has been given a 2nd Z-Skill that fires poison projectiles.

Bug Fixes
----------
- Removed a bug that could result in Lux stuck behind the Large Rock in Cringle Woods.
- Fixed a bug where a Cherub could be re-rescued each time you re-entered a room. 

Phew! A pretty long change list huh? You should see the full game, not too long to go now!

Thanks for reading this far and thanks for your support!

-Azzie
